founderHero.subtitle: Mother & Daughter • 29+ Years Fashion Pedigree
founderHero.headline: Meet Vicky & Samantha
founderHero.lead: I have worked in fashion for over 29 years, working with some of the biggest names on the British high street across clothing, shoes, lingerie, and jewellery. The only thing I hadn't done was bridal—and now I've been doing it for over 15 years.

pillars.title: Unrivalled Experience
pillars.description: I have worked with brides for years! And not just helping them find their gown—I have worked extensively as a professional wedding photographer, so I know how fabrics react to direct sunlight, venue chandeliers, flash photography, and movement throughout a 12-hour day.

pillars.title: We Truly Listen
pillars.description: Before we touch a single rail, we sit down over a cuppa to talk through your wedding plans. Understanding your venue, style, and personal comfort helps us envisage your day and guide you toward gowns that genuinely feel like you.

pillars.title: Complete Exclusivity
pillars.description: We lock and close the boutique for every appointment. You and your guests have our entire showroom, our mirrors, and our undivided attention with zero outside interruptions or competing brides.

pillars.title: We Love What We Do
pillars.description: We are passionate about making sure our brides look and feel extraordinary. We'll laugh together, share happy tears, and celebrate finding 'The One' with honest, pressure-free styling advice.
